text:
Kanbanr is set up for this project and `kanbanr doctor` is clean. Its only warning is that goal G-0 has no work linked yet, which is expected on a new board.

- **Board:** `../board` is its own git repo, with the remote `https://the-remote-server/togaf-v070-preview-5-board` added. The board README links the code repository.
- **Process:** TOGAF, with Zachman definitions, EARS requirements and tests on every item.
  - The design role sits at System Design.
  - The build role sits at Implementation.
  - The integrate role sits at Migration.
  - The release role sits at Operations.
- **Cadence:** sprints, releases and CI are on. I created no sprint and no release. I'll ask for those when you want the first one.
- **Git model:** items branch from `sprint/<SP>` and merge into it at Migration. `release/<V>` merges into `main` at the last release stage and is tagged. Automation is on, and I never push.
- **Charter:** it holds G-0 only, as you confirmed.
- **Repository:** the setup commit `1bbc785` is on `main`, and the git hooks are installed.
- **Setup record:** the plan is saved as the board doc `setup/2026-11-16-setup.md`.

**Waiting for you on the Review page:** DLG-001, a proposed delegation for the `docs-folded` sign-off at Implementation, for every item, until 2026-11-30. It covers nothing until you grant it. Once you do, I'll offer the Claude Code allow rule so I can use it in auto mode.

- Review: http://localhost:8080/p/project/review
- Releases: http://localhost:8080/p/project/releases

`kanbanr open --check` reports nothing answering on port 8080 from my shell. You said the monitor is already running with writes on, so I haven't started another. Check that it's reachable on your side before granting.

What would you like to scope first? The first release will also need its small CI pipeline item (one job, one platform).

That's the right page. Nothing is decided yet: the mode is still `monitor`, and DLG-001 is still proposed.

On the Review page, open the proposed delegation DLG-001 and grant or discard it. It covers only the `docs-folded` sign-off at Implementation, for every item, until 2026-11-30. To use it, the page's mode switch also has to be set to `delegated`. Both choices are yours.

My shell still can't reach port 8080. If the page doesn't load for you, tell me and I'll check how the monitor was started.

Tell me when you've decided. If you grant it, I'll then offer the Claude Code allow rule. After that, what would you like to scope first?

Option 1 it is, but I don't have the sentence yet. That message repeated my option text instead of describing the work, and the project has no product to infer one from.

What do you want built first? Say who it's for and what they can do, for example "a shopper opens their basket and finds it kept".

Setup is finished, and the board is empty and ready for work.

- **Board:** `../board`, with the remote `origin` added. The README links your code repository.
- **Process:** agile, with sprints and releases on and CI on. The setup commit `[no-ref] initial setup` is on `main`, and the git hooks are installed. `kanbanr git model` says `automation: on`, and `kanbanr git doctor` reports that the board and branches agree.
- **Charter:** the draft you confirmed is saved, with `G-0` as its only goal. The doctor check has one warning: `G-0` has no work linked to it yet, which is expected on a new board.
- **Decisions:** the mode is delegated. Two delegations are proposed and cover nothing until you grant them on the Review page, at http://localhost:8080/p/project/review:
  - **DLG-001:** the design-review sign-off for chores and defects.
  - **DLG-002:** the docs-folded sign-off for every item.
- **Monitor:** my check says nothing is answering at http://localhost:8080. You told me one is already running, so I started nothing. If that address doesn't load for you, tell me and I'll sort it out.
- **CI:** I'll design the one-job, one-platform pipeline with the first release. Nothing is pushed.

What would you like to build first?

Yes, that's what I set up. `../board` is the board, `origin` points at `https://the-remote-server/agile-v070-preview-2-board`, and the board README links `https://the-remote-server/agile-v070-preview-2-code`. I haven't pushed anything. Pushing the board is yours to do, or kanbanr syncs it after writes if you set that policy.

What would you like to build first? I'll scope it as an item with a definition, and you approve it on the Review page before any code is written.
